answer:
I don't know of an Ollama environment variable called `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT`, so I can't give a default for it. It may not exist, or it may be something newer or more obscure than what I know.

The closest setting I know of is `OLLAMA_KEEP_ALIVE`, which controls how long a model stays loaded in memory after a request. Its default is `5m` (5 minutes). You can also set it per request with the `keep_alive` parameter in the API.

If you saw `OLLAMA_UNLOAD_TIMEOUT` in some documentation or code, tell me where and I can help interpret it. You can also check the output of `ollama serve`, which logs the server config it picked up, or the `envconfig` package in the Ollama source.
